messages.subject: Project Cedar - legal DD enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Amelia,

Please find our first legal due diligence enquiry list for Project Cedar (sent via the data room Q&A). Priority items are the Caldera and Aerelon contracts, the NADCAP renewal position, the 2024 environmental report and the Doyle grievance file. Replies by 5 March would keep us on timetable.

Elena Marchetti

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
